_doc: Opening animation tables decoded from OPENING.C (ONWIN32.EXE, 0x428f88 .. OpeningSequence 0x42b16b). See the docstring of tools/analysis/ghidra/export_opening.py. Points are window pixels (already doubled).

news_cartoon.structure: 7 passes of 25 redraws; after passes 1..6 bulletin 0..5 is typed (the box is empty during pass 1); the redraws go on (every 10 ticks, by the clock) while typing

typing.note: 2 ticks wait + 1 tick alarm per character, newline 2 ticks

crew.pictures: bundle 9 items 15..25 = pictures 1016..1026: 1016-1019 man from behind (4 poses), 1020-1021 woman, 1022-1023 man turned / front, 1024-1026 the walking man
crew.record: [cmd, item, mirror, delay]: cmd -1 show the picture for `delay` calls; cmd -3 same, and move the sprite 12 px right on EVERY call of the record; the script ends with a lone byte -2: the previous record's picture is drawn once more and the script restarts (its x is NOT reset)

status_lights.rule: every call, each light independently: with probability 100/299 (rand() % 299 < 100) draw picture 1010 + r % 3 (r = that remainder); the lights at points 9, 10, 11 are drawn mirrored; otherwise the light is OFF (the strip is restored from the clean copy every call)

panel_lights.rule: every call, each light is ALWAYS drawn with picture 1013 + rand() % 299 % 3; the last four (points 16-19) are mirrored

speech.note: clip n (NE1SOUND 3999 + n) starts when the previous one has finished; before clips 1, 3, 6, 7 there is a pause of 219 (clip 1) / 248 ticks; clips 2, 4, 5, 8-11 follow at once

news_cartoon.end: after pass 7 (25 redraws after the last bulletin has been typed); Enter skips to the title scene, Space / Esc skip everything

title_scene.frame_note: frames[0] is the pre-frame (t = 0, parameter 0), frames[r] for r = 1..162 is loop iteration r - 1 (parameter r - 1) at t = 12 r ticks; positions are where the part is DRAWN in that frame

ship.wobble: after each draw y += -2 when param % 10 == 0, +2 when param % 10 == 5 (none while standing still); every part of the ship wobbles by the same amount

sub.note: the sub is NOT attached to the ship after the drop: it keeps the ship's x advance but is clipped to rows <= 312, so once its top row is at 313 or lower (it stops at y = 322) nothing of it is drawn. It sinks behind the wave strip, splashes, and is gone.

splash.note: sound on the trigger frame, nothing for the next frame, then one picture per redraw (5 redraws); both halves are drawn at the FIXED point 54 (the ship is standing still)

reveal_and_prompt.after_ship: at once (no fade): sky + clouds + sea redrawn without the ship, music stopped (0x33 + stop)

steps.action: show picture 1044 'The Learning Company Presents' at point 59 (a single blit, NO wipe), hold 292 ticks
erase it (sky / clouds redrawn over the strip)
show picture 1045 'OPERATION' at point 60, hold 292 ticks
show picture 1046 'NEPTUNE' at point 61 and the TEXT string 11001 (white, font colour 15) at point 62, with the two buttons

reveal_and_prompt.keys_during_holds: Enter, Space, Esc end the hold early; Space / Esc also abandon the whole opening
